thesis_text: Applied Digital keeps growing quarter on quarter: revenue and adjusted EBITDA beat last quarter's $258.7M and $42.4M as more capacity comes online, the net loss narrows from $110.6M, and they announce another lease. I'd put $100 at risk at most.
drafted_by: Claude Code from cited pre-event sources
baseline_method: Use the declared pre-close window ending at 16:00 ET; do not anchor it to the unknown release timestamp.
capture_plan: Capture RAPLDUSDT one-minute market candles, the public UTA v3 SPOT order book and ticker, with exchange and local receipt timestamps, from 15:30 through 20:00 ET on 2026-10-07. Also attempt public SPOT fills and the account-scoped Reality order book and fills as separately labelled provenance. A protected-route 40025 response does not invalidate a slot when the required candles and public order book were captured. If either required interval is missing, or the issuer release time cannot be verified from the issuer's own publication, mark the run INCOMPLETE.

approved_comparison_rules.revenue beats last quarter: ABOVE_REFERENCE; quarterly revenues above the frozen $258.7 million (Q4 FY26, continuing operations).
approved_comparison_rules.adjusted EBITDA beats last quarter: ABOVE_REFERENCE; issuer-defined quarterly Adjusted EBITDA above the frozen $42.4 million.
approved_comparison_rules.net loss narrows: BELOW_REFERENCE; quarterly net loss attributable to common stockholders below the frozen $110.6 million. If the issuer reports net income instead, the claim is not addressed by this rule.
approved_comparison_rules.another lease: ABOVE_REFERENCE; issuer-stated contracted critical IT load above the frozen 1,410 MW.
